criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1 and 3 to 5 are real material renders with cast shadows, and the counts match figures.json (19 on slide 6 with no end cap, 12 with both caps, 4 plus a cleaved half). Slides 2, 6 and 9 are flat plates seen face on; slide 9 is mostly a type label, and slide 2 is a square tile with a typed label sitting in a void.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One unit of $1 million per wafer runs from the cover through slides 3 to 6 and on to slide 9's 19 empty sockets, and the register stays dark. Slide 2's terracotta tile and slide 7's copper islands sit outside the wafer and boat vocabulary.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to c1, c2, c15 to c17, c19 or figures.json, and every quote is from a fetched ttu.edu page. 'A cluster not built yet' is c4's reading of 'will help establish', slide 9 files the dollar-unit wafers as 19 empty IN SERVICE sockets, and the CHIPS Office fact rests on a university page.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where are named. There is no deadline, meeting or step a Texan can take.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe. Slide 2 is a weak payoff, slides 3 to 5 are a slow ledger that slide 6 sums up, and the close repeats the cover's absence rather than turning.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on house rules, with honest hedges. Slide 7 reads close to the press release, and nothing makes it sound local.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat in 30 days. The story shape matches no. 65, no. 73 was research computing three days earlier, and the 'one object per $X' device has been the house move since late October.

one_sentence_fix: Replace the flat slide 2 tile with a physically lit Lubbock scene that carries the wafer boat, and recast slide 9's IN SERVICE row so it does not reuse dollar-unit wafers as hardware slots.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A face-on terracotta square on tiles with a typed label, a flat drawing with no subject, scale or light direction.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the cover's wafer boat on a raised caliche relief of Lubbock County, lit low from one side.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A brushed-metal label plate filled with type; the 19 dark sockets read as a UI.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Show the cover's boat again, empty with 19 unlit slots, under one work light, and drop the typed plate rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A top-down orthographic tray that reads as a chart.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera to a 30-degree raking angle so the three boats stand as objects with long cast shadows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A small die-patterned wafer in a grey haze with no contact shadow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the camera in until the wafer runs off the right and bottom edges, seat it on a dark chuck with a hard contact shadow, and give it one bright rim edge.
